inclusion_rule: Studies that synthesize a speech waveform from talking-face or lip video together with text: the script given as input (visual TTS, automated video or movie dubbing) or text predicted by a lip reader and used to condition synthesis (text-aware video-to-speech). Boundary: plain video-to-speech without any text conditioning, talking-head generation (speech or text to face video), audio-visual recognition, and cascades that only run an off-the-shelf TTS on lip-read text without using the video in synthesis are excluded; versions of one study count once; design counts are full-text pattern counts (upper bound, related-work mentions included).
